content:
Hi good people from the lean community, I believe there's a typo in chapter 7 of "Theorem Proving for Lean4" and it is still there in the latest commit.
In line 693, Sigma type is the dependent sum type, not the dependent product type.
I opened a PR last December, and it has not been merged.

Here's the link https://github.com/leanprover/theorem_proving_in_lean4/pull/203

Thanks
No, this is correct. If the second type does not depend on the first, then you get something equivalent to a product type
Oh I see, the terminology was already defined in the dependent type theory section. I missed it, my bad sry.

But many external resources do call the sigma-type the dependent sum and the pi-type the dependent product. Should I open a pr to add a small footnote or something to clarify? For a beginner like me it will definitely clear a lot of ambiguity up.
I am not a maintainer of TPIL, but adding more details here sounds reasonable to me

Yep PR Opened here (leanprover/theorem_proving_in_lean4, PR 225)
Would appreciate a review when anyone has spare time!
